title: OneMind services registry
description: The image's services.yaml (/usr/lib/onemind/services.yaml, issue #623): one entry per systemd unit the OS ships, with a plain name and description. It lives on the read-only, signed OS image, so only an OS update changes it. test/unit/test_services_registry.py fails when a unit under os/ has no entry.

name.description: Plain name a person reads on the service card.

description.description: Plain words: what it does and what stops working without it.

docs.description: Repo path of the page that explains it.

restartable.description: Whether a person may ask for a restart (an owner-approved action, later work). Rescue, first boot, host and data-layout units are never restartable.

risk.description: low: stopping it pauses a background job; medium: a feature stops for everyone until it is back; high: the box may not boot, lose data or lock people out.
